rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for tolerating something unpleasant or painful.

example.english: I can't endure this much noise.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jan2 sau6 m4 dou2 gam3 cou4

rows.note: Use this for getting through prolonged hardship or for something lasting under difficult conditions, rather than for neutral continuation.

example.english: Once we endure this most difficult period, things will be fine.
example.traditional: 捱過呢段最辛苦嘅日子就好喇。
example.jyutping: ngaai4 gwo3 ni1 dyun6 zeoi3 san1 fu2 ge3 jat6 zi2 zau6 hou2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a situation, process, or relationship continuing or lasting without emphasizing hardship or personal effort.

example.english: This relationship did endure for many years.
example.traditional: 呢段關係持續咗好多年。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 gwaan1 hai6 ci4 zuk6 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4

rows.note: Use this when a person deliberately keeps going despite obstacles or opposition.

example.english: Even without anyone's support, I will endure and keep going.
example.traditional: 就算冇人支持，我都會堅持落去。
example.jyutping: zau6 syun3 mou5 jan4 zi1 ci4 ngo5 dou1 wui5 gin1 ci4 lok6 heoi3
